ui_bugs.issue: Approve & publish button (testID 'prompt-publish') never renders after saving a draft. Root cause: GET /api/admin/prompts/{key} returns the raw prompt doc which has `pending` field but not the derived `has_pending` boolean. The component checks `d.has_pending` (line 157) which is undefined => publish button and discard button never show. Fix: either add `has_pending: bool(d.get('pending'))` in the single-prompt endpoint response (/app/backend/server.py line ~7295), or change the frontend to check `d.pending != null` (/app/frontend/src/components/admin/PromptLibraryModule.tsx line 157).

action_items: Fix prompt-publish button not showing after save. Simplest fix (frontend): change PromptLibraryModule.tsx lines ~157 and ~166 from `d.has_pending` to `d.pending != null` (or better: also expose has_pending in single-prompt endpoint response for API consistency).

Optional: after publish, `has_pending` in the list endpoint stays fresh but detail sheet reload works via GET /admin/prompts/{key} so state stays consistent; still recommend adding `has_pending` to detail response for parity.

rca_of_issue: BUG: 'Approve & publish' button never appears after saving a draft in the Admin Prompt Library workstation. REPRODUCE: 1) Log in as admin, go to /admin, click AI Prompt Library, open any prompt (e.g. quick_answer). 2) Edit content in prompt-content textarea (button 'Save draft' becomes enabled). 3) Click prompt-save (backend correctly stores pending; verified via curl: GET /api/admin/prompts/quick_answer returns pending=<new content>). 4) EXPECTED: 'Approve & publish' (testID prompt-publish) and 'Discard' buttons appear next to 'Save draft'. ACTUAL: neither button renders. ROOT CAUSE: The single-prompt detail endpoint `GET /api/admin/prompts/{key}` in /app/backend/server.py (line ~7295) returns the raw Mongo doc containing `pending` field, but does NOT compute or return the `has_pending` boolean. However /app/frontend/src/components/admin/PromptLibraryModule.tsx line 157 gates the publish button on `d.has_pending` (a field only present in the list endpoint's response). Since `d.has_pending` is undefined in the detail response, the publish/discard block never renders. MITIGATION: Simplest one-line frontend fix: change occurrences of `d.has_pending` to `d.pending != null` in PromptLibraryModule.tsx (line 72 for the list card DRAFT PENDING badge uses r.has_pending on Row which is correct, so leave that; lines 157 and 166 in PromptDetail need to use d.pending != null). OR: server-side fix by adding `has_pending: bool(d.get('pending'))` into the response at server.py line 7303.
